name: Adamantine Bones
body:
School necromancy; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full round
Components V, S, M (1 lb. of adamantine per skeleton)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).
Target skeletons with total HD equal to 1 HD/level
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

One or more skeletons within range with total HD equal to 1 HD per caster level gain DR 10/adamantine. This DR stacks with the skeleton’s normal DR.
